intent: Prove distributed GPU workloads are admitted and placed atomically on an acceptable topology before workload SLO testing.
provider_examples: scheduler implementation exposing equivalent gang/topology evidence

measurements.meaning: time from workload admission request to admitted/reserved state
time from admission request until the complete distributed workload is ready
GPU devices assigned to the admitted workload
ready workload members divided by declared members

invariants: partial placement must not be reported as successful gang admission
assigned GPU count must match the declared workload request
topology placement must be recorded as evidence rather than inferred from aggregate GPU count
startup latency threshold must come from an explicit site/workload baseline
pending_site_baselines: allowed topology domains / distance for each workload class
